t:
(a) In General.—The President is authorized to assist Burmese democracy activists who are dedicated to nonviolent opposition to the SPDC in their efforts to promote freedom, democracy, and human rights in Burma. 
    (b) Authorization of Appropriations.—There are authorized to be appropriated $5,000,000 to the Secretary of State for fiscal year 2008 to—
        (1) provide aid to democracy activists in Burma; 
        (2) provide aid to individuals and groups conducting democracy programming outside of Burma targeted at a peaceful transition to constitutional democracy inside Burma; and 
        (3) expand radio and television broadcasting into Burma.

fable.w: The tempting reading is that outside parties (Burmese democracy activists, individuals and groups) are named, so the section involves participation. But these outsiders are only recipients of federal aid and assistance; they are not consulted and have no role in any federal decision. The section authorizes assistance and appropriations, with no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation, rulemaking, or right to sue.
fable.s: The President is authorized to assist Burmese democracy activists who are dedicated to nonviolent opposition to the SPDC in their efforts to promote freedom, democracy, and human rights in Burma.

opus.w: This section lets the President help Burmese democracy activists and sets aside money for aid and broadcasting. The activists receive the aid; the federal government does not consult them or ask for their input before making a decision. It may look like participation because outside groups and individuals are named, but this is aid going out, like a grant or benefit. There is no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation requirement or right to sue.
opus.s: The President is authorized to assist Burmese democracy activists who are dedicated to nonviolent opposition to the SPDC in their efforts to promote freedom, democracy, and human rights in Burma.

qwen_chat.w: This section authorizes the appropriation of funds to provide aid to outside groups. The definition explicitly excludes 'applications for benefits or grants' from participation. There is no requirement for consultation, coordination, or advisory input from these outside parties before the government makes a decision; the interaction is limited to the provision of financial assistance.
qwen_chat.s: There are authorized to be appropriated $5,000,000 to the Secretary of State for fiscal year 2008 to— (1) provide aid to democracy activists in Burma; (2) provide aid to individuals and groups conducting democracy programming outside of Burma targeted at a peaceful transition to constitutional democracy inside Burma; and (3) expand radio and television broadcasting into Burma.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that providing aid to "democracy activists" or "individuals and groups" constitutes participation because it involves outside parties. However, the definition explicitly states that "applications for benefits or grants" are not participation. This section authorizes the appropriation of funds to provide aid (grants) to these groups. It does not require the government to consult with them, hold public hearings, or include them in an advisory body before making a decision. The interaction is purely financial assistance, not collaborative decision-making.
